brief:
An-Najah National University launched the second edition of TEDI-Najah Expo 2026 under the patronage of Dr. Rami Hamadallah, vice chair of the university's board of trustees and chair of An-Najah National University Hospital's board, the Ma'an news agency reported. The event was organized in strategic partnership with Nablus Business Forum.

The expo aims to showcase entrepreneurial initiatives and business opportunities within the university community.
